objective: Continue the accepted arithmetic R8 model-mask checkpoint through literal rounds R9-R20 with eight parallel failure-diversified repair branches per round.

contract.intervention: At every MLP down_proj input, multiply every unselected channel by zero on every forward; no donor activations; attention, embeddings, norms, residuals, and selected channels remain live.
contract.recovery: masked_correct / dense_correct on the same records and same repaired model
contract.terminal_holdout_policy: The R8 holdout was previously opened. Freeze the same 2,000 pairs and compact/spaced records, exclude them from all R9-R20 training and selection, and evaluate R8 plus the frozen R20 winner exactly once after the tree is frozen. Report this as a reused fixed evaluation set, not a newly sealed holdout.

selection.candidate_space: For each repaired branch, evaluate the unchanged parent, parent-only shrink, and bounded score-ranked swaps at 110,000, 120,000, and 126,661 channels retaining 100%, 99.5%, or 99% of each candidate budget from the parent. Global top-k is diagnostic only.
selection.acceptance: A child must pass calibration and development recovery/class gates and score at least 497/500 dense on development. At the parent budget it must improve masked development correct by at least one. A smaller passing child is a valid size-quality frontier improvement.
selection.winner_order: smallest budget, then highest development masked correct, highest calibration masked correct, highest parent retention, lowest branch index
selection.exhaustion: If no eligible child from any of eight failure-driven repair branches passes at a depth, retain the incumbent unchanged and continue fresh failure-diversified repair branches at every remaining depth through R20.

artifacts.teardown: Only after immutable upload listing and local/remote SHA-256 verification.
